message: 先の人

name: Nanaka
message: 「Oh... you came too, Synn.」

name: Synn
message: 「You're worried about Lolotte yourself, aren't you, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「You're one to talk, Synn.」
Class 1-D. Lolotte's classroom on the first floor.
Students are heading out in twos and threes, though plenty of others are still lingering in the room, chatting away about nothing in particular.
It has nothing to do with studying, yet moments like these are an important part of school life too.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Rolo-chan's not here... Though I might actually be a little relieved.」

name: Synn
message: 「Me too. I came all this way, but I have no idea what to say to her.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Tahahaha, same here.」

name: Synn
message: 「Sometimes you don't need to overthink things beforehand--just meeting up and talking naturally can sort things out.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That's definitely what those two need.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「That girl Amyrina and... screw it, I'm just gonna call her Emi-chan!」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It kinda seems like Rolo-chan and Emi-chan are having a fight, right?」

name: Synn
message: 「If anything, I'd call it a cold war.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「It's an issue between friends, so as their upperclassman, I really shouldn't butt in, you know...」

name: Synn
message: 「Looking out for your underclassmen is a good thing.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Thanks...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「First-year classrooms sure bring back memories.」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ever since we became second-years and moved up to the second floor, I took it for granted and never really noticed, but the view from the windows is totally different.」

name: Synn
message: 「You used to hold strategy meetings in the classroom after school all the time to revive the Sweets Club, didn't you, Nanaka?」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Ahahaha, yeah, I did!」
I'm tempted to stay right here and keep talking with Nanaka forever.
At the same time, feeling the first-years glancing over in our direction starts to make me feel out of place.

name: Nanaka
message: 「Teehee, guess we're sticking out like sore thumbs, huh?」

name: Synn
message: 「Well, when two upperclassmen--and Student Council officers at that--walk into a first-year classroom, it can't be helped」

name: Nanaka
message: 「We just happened to run into her, but maybe Ria-senpai and Misa came by to check on things too?」

name: Synn
message: 「Yeah, that's possible」

name: Nanaka
message: 「If we keep standing around chatting in a first-year classroom like this, we're just gonna end up bothering Lolo-chan」

name: Synn
message: 「Right, let's make ourselves scarce」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Yeah, this isn't really our place to hang around」

name: Nanaka
message: 「Well, I'll still see Lolo-chan at the Student Council and the Crusaders, and besides...」

name: Nanaka
message: 「To be totally honest, I don't really have the time to be fussing over underclassmen right now anyway. Ahahaha」
